input: text is a lowercase ASCII string of length n <= 10000000. Empty input is allowed. Python integers exclude bool; standard containers/built-ins only. Preconditions are declared, not checked. Size bounds do not promise runtime feasibility.
return: Length of the longest nonempty proper contiguous substring such that every character occurring in it occurs nowhere outside it; return -1 if none. The entire string is excluded.
mutation_aliasing: No caller-owned input is mutated. No state survives on the Solution instance. Scalar/string results have value semantics; private work containers do not escape.
numeric: Only indices and lengths at most n are computed; all are exact safe integers.
complexity: O(26*n+1) expected time and O(26) auxiliary space, with no per-position character-ID array. Any admissible left boundary is a first occurrence; scan until an outside-left occurrence invalidates it.
source_accounting: The complete standalone source is 719 UTF-8 bytes, including class/method wrappers, fully included helper definitions where present, built-ins, allocations, whitespace and terminal newline. Every helper is stored and charged. No hidden library or source expansion. A frozen solve-entry adapter must also be stored and charged before measurement.
